meta.sampleNote: 150 schools, not a pure random sample: the wide25 test set + 15 lowest + 15 highest ranked + 95 seeded random (seed 20261026), drawn from 562 captured higher ed sites. Each page was read by two AI readers, Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.6, at temperature 0; only promises both readers agreed on are counted. Theme share = schools with an agreed promise in that theme / 150 schools with any agreed promise (barnard.edu had none). Support shares are over 347 agreed promises. Proof kinds count 582 evidence spans from both readers, labelled by a Haiku pass; T0 kinds map to engine kinds as operational_practice=operating_mechanism, documented_outcome=reported_outcome, funded_commitment=published_policy, documented_experience=example_or_story, restated_claim and third_party_recognition unchanged, announced_intention has no engine equivalent (engineKind null). Examples are verbatim agreed sentences with no digits, names or places.

themes.label: Access and affordability
examples: Financial worries shouldn't hold you back.
An affordable college education is not one-size-fits-all.
When we say "affordable," we mean it.
You can put a price on quality.
Life's busy and you've got bills to pay.

themes.label: Career outcomes
examples: Step effortlessly into your career right after graduation.
Complete a required internship experience so you're equipped with real-work experience.
That means we are dedicated to making sure you achieve your goals and graduate with skills for success.
The ongoing success of our students beyond graduation is proof positive that you can confidently pursue your education here.

themes.label: Belonging and community
examples: Great things happen when you're part of a community that believes in you.
Here, you'll find community, grow in your faith, and make unforgettable memories along the way.
Here, you'll build lifelong friendships, create lasting memories and find a place that truly feels like home.
Our students know they belong to a diverse and inclusive community, free to explore and express their individuality.
From the moment you arrive on our beautiful campus, you'll belong to a community that challenges you, supports you and wants the best for you.

themes.label: Hands-on, real-world learning
examples: Dream it, learn it, do it.
It's not just our motto, it's our practice.
Leaving your comfort zone to land somewhere better.
Our nationally recognized programs connect learning to the needs of a fast-growing region.
Our students unleash their potential through hands-on learning, research opportunities, study abroad programs, and more.

themes.label: A better world and purpose
examples: This is bigger than a degree.

They come here to build lifelong connections and find a community of kindred spirits focused on the greater good.

themes.label: Your own path and flexibility
examples: Find the program that's right for you.
We can help you reach your goals.

themes.label: Personal attention
examples: Big enough to take you anywhere.

themes.label: Tradition, values and faith
examples: We're here to prepare you not only for a career, but for a calling.
Here, you're surrounded by people who genuinely care, encourage your dreams, and celebrate your journey.

themes.label: Rigor and academic excellence
examples: It's hard work, and it's personal.
We take you seriously as scholars and as thinkers.
